run_conformance_test: run the protobuf conformance test by piping serialized ConformanceRequest messages into stdin
test_do_test: test the do_test function with a ConformanceRequest containing a protobuf or JSON payload
test_do_test_io: test the do_test_io function that reads length-delimited messages from stdin and writes responses to stdout
review_ProtocolError: review the ProtocolError custom exception class used for protocol-level errors in conformance testing
summarize_conformance_runner: summarize the conformance test runner main loop that processes requests until EOF
